svg.title: How TimelineXray is built
svg.desc: Four tiers in one column. Source: the public upstream repository and a local snapshot store of pinned commits. Evidence: manifest, exact spans, code index with parameters. Knowledge: findings ledger, diffs and digests. Access: the txray command line and a read-only MCP server.
